question: For each newly reached weight-three first-flux sector, what is the exact complete all-zero-charge first-record likelihood of its canonical three-edge private error, and how much disjoint physical joint mass do these base records contribute?
fork_classification: J8T prospectively established that all 7,020 new canonical-base laws fit in 9,360 exact terms. This is a dependent execution of that prerequisite, not a human choice between diagnostics. Operator relabeling and action-conditioned second-law reduction remain separate unproved alternatives; no pooling is used here.

hypotheses.uniform_by_structural_class: The new canonical-base first likelihood depends only on the number of variable first sites or a frozen flux/prior class.
hypotheses.diverse: At least one matched structural class has different exact canonical-base likelihoods; avoid a class-pooling shortcut.
hypotheses.censored: A source, commutation, cost or runtime gate fails; no partial law cohort is promoted.

frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 operator orbit with 36 IID red-X physical edges at p_X=1/10, p_Z=0. The signal-only pre-action first observation is the full 24-site binary flux/charge/vacuum public record, with all charge bits zero and vacuum=1-charge for each sector's prospectively selected lexicographic three-edge base. Private support is generation/scoring-only. Relation-free actions and action-conditioned second records remain frozen but unevaluated.

matrix.selection: Use J8T's 7,020 new first-flux sectors and the already frozen lexicographically first three-edge private representative per sector; no post-law selection.
branches: Evaluate the exact complete all-zero-charge first-record Born likelihood for each new canonical base using every eligible commuting first-star projector, with deterministic +1 sites reduced and no hidden support exposed to a decoder.

Aggregate likelihood counts and exact disjoint base-error/first-record joint mass, add the immutable J8Q at-most-two cohort only across disjoint first-flux sectors, and compare with exact reached-sector prior without inferring missing same-flux private-error laws.
matrix.independent_unit: One distinct first-flux sector and its frozen canonical three-edge private base; exact rational probabilities, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin J8T/J8Q and operator sources plus runner; replay 7,020 unique new sectors disjoint from 667 old, 9,360 projected terms and p_X=1/10 prior; verify eligible first sites, pairwise commutation, variable-site list and term count per row, q in [0,1], one-site q=1/2 and zero-site q=1 controls, disjoint joint-mass bounds, CPU/term/hash stability, zero second laws/histories/arms/bootstraps. No private support in public action input.

acceptance: All 7,020 new canonical-base complete first laws pass normalization/structural/source gates within 9,360 terms
Exact likelihood distribution and new plus cumulative disjoint base-record joint contributions are reported against sector-prior bounds
No equal-prior public-law symmetry, full-IID information/risk, action-conditioned second law, noisy JIT or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after all 7,020 frozen bases or first integrity/9,360-term/60-CPU-second cap. Do not add alternative errors, first records, second actions/laws, histories, bootstraps or dependencies. Failure censors the batch and requires separate diagnosis; no partial promotion.
